discussion.body:
The Titanfall Engine utilises Cascading Shadow Maps for dynamic shadows
On most graphics settings you will see dynamic lighting, this is how R5Reloaded devs where able to create "World's Edge After Dark"
(Before Respawn released an official version, many seasons later)

But on lower spec hardware & graphics settings (and possibly also at far distances), the engine still relies on pre-baked lightmaps.

Lightmaps utilise 3 main lumps:
 * `LIGHTMAP_HEADERS`
 * `LIGHTMAP_DATA_SKY`
 * `LIGHTMAP_DATA_REAL_TIME_LIGHTS` or `RTL`

`LIGHTMAP_DATA_REAL_TIME_LIGHTS_PAGE` also exists, but appears to be empty (used in some memory management trick?)

`LIGHTMAP_HEADERS` is indexed by `MESHES` (renderable `.bsp` geo)
Each LightmapHeader indexes into both `SKY` & `RTL`
A series of bytes can be read in with a specific Pixel format to load an uncompressed image (probably fed directly to the GPU)
The format & count vary from game to game, so we'll get into specific examples below.

nodes.body:
# Titanfall
For each `LIGHTMAP_HEADER` Titanfall produces 2 `SKY` lightmaps & 1 `RTL`
All pixels are `RGBA32`

`SKY` `B` lightmaps look like a normal map
Unsure if this is used for global illumination or shadows (bounce along axis vs. block along axis)

`RTL` seems to only be shades of grey & blue, we'll get deeper into `RTL` theory with Titanfall 2

> NOTE: samples extract each lightmap the stitch them into panels

## Sample
```python
>>> import bsp_tool
>>> from bsp_tool.extensions import lightmaps
>>> lightmaps.save_rbsp_r1(bsp_tool.load_bsp("E:/Mod/Titanfall/maps/mp_colony.bsp"))
```
### `mp_colony.bsp.sky.png`
![mp_colony bsp sky](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/36507175/228558851-3a8dbe56-928c-4e4c-b472-85585bb56114.png)

### `mp_colony.bsp.rtl.png`
![mp_colony bsp rtl](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/36507175/228559085-dcc00f8d-cfb6-4dcc-b292-ec01e463ed98.png)

Converted `mp_corporate` to `.gltf` recently and visualised lightmaps:
top-left: `SkyB.rgb`
bottom-left: `SkyA.rgb * SkyA.a`
![corporate_gltf_passes](https://github.com/snake-biscuits/bsp_tool/assets/36507175/d859a1fd-5d1f-4a16-a5b2-6af60a5dbdad)
`SkyA.rgb * SkyA.a * RTLB.a`
![corporate_gltf_rtl_b_alpha](https://github.com/snake-biscuits/bsp_tool/assets/36507175/1f3d1bbe-0445-4830-ae42-d5f6467973b3)
`RTL B`'s Alpha channel appears to be a hard on-off shadow map for sun shadows

# Titanfall 2
Titanfall 2 has `A` & `B` lightmaps for both `SKY` & `RTL`

If the `RTL` lump is internal, the engine expects "9 bytes per texel" & will throw an error
We've tried to extract the 1/4 size `RTL` `C` lightmap, but it appears to always be white (dummy data?)

All lightmaps are still `RGBA32`

`SKY` `A` & `B` seem to work the same as in Titanfall
`RTL` `A` appears to be a mask (all white, holes punched in alpha)
`RTL` `B` looks to be light indices encoded as colour (variable names decompiled from shaders seem to confirm this)

## Sample
```python
>>> import bsp_tool
>>> from bsp_tool.extensions import lightmaps
>>> lightmaps.save_rbsp_r2(bsp_tool.load_bsp("E:/Mod/Titanfall2/maps/mp_colony02.bsp"))
```
> NOTE: `save_rbsp_r2` generates `.json` for splitting up panels & writing back changes to the exported images
### `mp_colony_02.bsp.sky.png`
![mp_colony02 bsp sky](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/36507175/228563265-23deca8d-16a8-40b9-85d1-27db8abc35a5.png)

### `mp_colony_02.bsp.rtl.png`
![mp_colony02 bsp rtl](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/36507175/228564437-9bd96b7f-35e0-4fd1-a611-30f827977adf.png)

# Apex Legends
Apex Legends lightmaps aren't as well mapped atm

Once again, `RTL` has changed (5 bytes-per-texel)
`RTL` is also much harder to see, and with current performance, it's difficult to test multiple samples
At present I'm extracting 1x `RGBA32` @ 1/1 size & 1x `RGBA32` @ 1/4 size

Season 3's lobby probably isn't the best example, but I don't want to push GitHub's upload limits
Feel free to try out other maps w/ `extensions.lightmaps`
You'll need to install Pillow w/ pip (or `pip install bsp_tool[extended]`)
The `from bsp_tool.extensions import lightmaps` syntax is important: `import bsp_tool.extensions` will not load any extensions!
> this is so you don't get any errors using `bsp_tool` without installing any dependencies

## Sample
```python
>>> import bsp_tool
>>> from bsp_tool.extensions import lightmaps
>>> lightmaps.save_rbsp_r5(bsp_tool.load_bsp("E:/Mod/ApexLegends/season3/3dec19/maps/mp_lobby.bsp"))
```
### `mp_lobby.bsp.sky.png`
![mp_lobby bsp sky](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/36507175/228567463-257828dc-b94b-4e1e-80e3-73f2d492985e.png)

### `mp_lobby.bsp.rtl.png`
![mp_lobby bsp rtl](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/36507175/228567557-b42e82fc-b6f8-4d10-a492-a65b3a72f84f.png)

nodes.body:
It occured to me that maybe some arenas maps would make for good samples
Turns out their `RTL` is just as indecipherable

If only respawn would do some lazy ports of old maps that still use prominent `RTL` lighting
(Assuming Apex' `RTL` is so hard to see because it's subtle)

# RTL
Regarding `RTL`, I think it replaces the Quake / Source lighting styles system
What lighting entities I've seen seem to support flicker patterns, but I've yet to confirm it
MRVN-Radiant can't produce lit maps yet after all

Source-style lighting styles are probably also emulated via `RTL`

I would really like to build a sdk map for lighting & capture video evidence of flicker patterns in Respawn Source
Would be cool to present that alongside some Half-Life: Alyx lighting filckers

nodes.body:
btw, no idea how exactly `RTL` indices are encoded
also don't know the distinction between `WORLDLIGHTS` & lights in entity lumps
(presumably naming a light source makes it dynamic, like in source?)

Titanfall 2 allows for dynamic `light_environment`, zone-locked `light_environment` & multiple `sky_camera`s, so who knows

We are closer to getting lighting in MRVN-Radiant now:
 * https://github.com/MRVN-Radiant/MRVN-Radiant/issues/61

Needs some work on packing texels & culling faces
Also requires `.rpak` materials
